output.summary: A large non-woody evergreen perennial whose wild form is native from South Africa north to Ethiopia and west to the Congo. It has huge banana-like leaves and flowers only once, at the end of its life. In Ethiopia, its cooked heart and corm are eaten, while pulverised trunk and flower stalk are fermented into kocho or processed into bulla; the fruits are inedible.
